test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Identify the ODD one out.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Construction.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The odd one out is Construction, as it does not belong to the service sector whereas the other options do.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• Hotels and restaurants, Banking and insurance, and Transport and communication are all service sector industries.
 
• Service sector:-
 
 
• It is the largest sector of the economy and includes industries that provide services rather than tangible goods.
